decisions.reason: The firm has kept this service visible on its own page for two years and it fits closely with its core e-commerce relaunch and SEO business, so escalation of commitment and strategic fit make withdrawal unlikely unless results clearly worsen.

This workshop offer is newer and likely required less sunk investment than a core operational service, but it is publicly presented on its own page and aligns with the firm's marketing and advisory capabilities, so management is still somewhat more likely to continue than to drop it.
